checks: Recomputed frozen run plan and five individual case hashes; compared preview, ledger sourcePlan and exported DB plan exactly.
Matched exact source SHA across deployment, serving identity, pre-dispatch and all result metadata; checked source commit byte hashes against frozen runtime policy.
Matched all four public case exports with final run, ledger raw captures and exported database results, fixed case order and single attempted row per position.

Checked three lossless/untruncated complete paragraph captures, STOP finishes, unique response IDs, selected-provider transport and frozen request briefs; checked fourth null capture/usage and exact 60000ms pre-header abort.
Recomputed 49808 + 66502 + 63946 = 180256 known-usage accounting micros, plus 2800000 uncertain reservation = 2980256, below the 5000000 ceiling.
Checked three new request starts after recorded browser closure and no fifth result or request record.
Checked corrected summary classification, blind packet hashes and literal body inclusion, review input/body identities, recorded source passes and independent reader threshold failures.
Compared final active/off state and historical receipt fingerprints with baseline; checked cleanup, retained ownership/results and absence of synthetic member data.
Compared all 153 prior tracked report/artifact files exactly with their pre-revision Git bytes; performed no remote action.
Checked final report, verification and qualification claims against saved results; verified whole-suite/build log hashes and source identity without rerunning tests or builds.
Compared public database-capture receipt byte lengths and SHA256 values with exact raw result strings in the saved DB export.
Compared final public/private session-cleanup receipts and verified the local storage-state file is absent.

resolvedObservations: The summary timeout is now correctly classified as automaticUnavailable=1, automaticRejected=0 and unrequestedCases=1; it is not a rejected generated draft.
limits: This audit made no network/provider call, production database read or write, deployment, activation or authenticated Today call. It evaluated saved receipts and captures with local file and Git operations only.

The three captureLossless bodies are preserved structured model paragraph captures, matched across saved run, ledger, database export, public capture and blind-review packets. Raw provider wire envelopes or provider dashboard logs were not independently available.

Exactly four attempts are established for this recorded campaign by the matching ledger and database export, with one entry per fixed position, three unique response IDs and the deployed zero-retry/single-provider controls. This is not a site-wide vendor usage audit.

The fourth attempt has no received headers/body, response ID, actual model or usage. Its timeout cause and actual charge are unknown. A 2800000-micro conservative reservation remains; no invoice was verified.

The three historical run and 15 historical result fingerprints match between saved baseline and final receipts. This reviewer inspected the finalizer query ordering and assertions but did not fetch or independently rehash the raw historical database rows. All 153 tracked historical report/artifact files were independently compared byte-for-byte with pre-revision 02e32f5.

Recorded browser closure followed the first attempt start by 125 milliseconds. The other three attempts began after closure, and the first response plus terminal capture followed it. This supports server continuation within those timestamps; it is not physical-device or browser-lifecycle coverage.

Reader/source judgments belong to the separate independent agents. This audit checked their packet/body identities, numeric threshold arithmetic and recorded outcomes without regrading any body. These are AI reviews, not human or member research.

The terminal run has incomplete five-case coverage: three full generated bodies, one unavailable timeout and one unrequested case. It cannot qualify the complete five-mode set or establish every context comparison.

No explicit frozen-contract prohibition on separately qualifying a fully captured mode was found. That is a narrow textual inference from the report scope and pre-dispatch per-mode process, not new authorization or qualification. Here all three recorded reader reviews fail, so no individual mode qualifies regardless of that interpretation.
No authenticated authored member route/storage proof occurred because no generated mode qualified; no temporary authored rollout was enabled and no sixth uncached model call is authorized or claimed.

The final serving endpoint receipt proves source identity only; it does not establish authenticated member delivery or model activation. Local credential-artifact removal is directly checked; the no-published-credential statement is recorded from the saved cleanup receipt, without retaining or re-reading the removed cookie value.
